verdict.rationale: GitHub Actions automates and executes development workflows in the repository and is positioned as CI/CD. The REST and GraphQL APIs, authenticated with fine-grained personal access tokens, plus the official GitHub CLI give programmatic, non-GUI ways to drive the product. Missing for 10: explicit docs on running gh or Copilot CLI non-interactively inside CI pipelines (e.g. token-based auth in CI, headless agent invocation), and independent or hands-on corroboration of headless automation.
